title: F1 skeptic-minimal: KRYPTOS-only sub + columnar (the disciplined null)
hypothesis_summary: Skeptic-minimal counterpart to the F1 proponents. It refuses to elevate disclosed crib spans to key-role status without independent evidence. Instead it tests only the construction-attested keyword KRYPTOS (the sculpture's name and the alphabet keyword used in K1/K2/K3) as a substitution + columnar key. This is the disciplined null version of the disclosed-crib pack family — if the cribs DO function as keys, F1-11/12 should beat this pack; if they do not, this pack defines the within-family floor.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: KRYPTOS is the sculpture name and the K1/K2/K3 alphabet keyword (TIER_SCULPTURE_CONTEXT in the project clue registry).

composition_templates.rationale: Single-keyword sub + columnar with KRYPTOS in both roles. Within-family floor.
Beaufort form of the same role-pair.

constraints: KRYPTOS is the only keyword. Single-keyword fallback path in the i3 emitter.
caveats: SKEPTIC-MINIMAL framing — establishes the floor against which F1-11/12 must outperform to claim crib-as-key signal.
KRYPTOS as a Vigenere key has been tested historically; confidence reflects this.
